issues.reason: A bare strength-0.0 bundle asserts the magazine does not glorify the administration, whereas "not necessarily" denies only the necessity — over-assertion under the calibration line, and the negation section's own "Bob can't cook" / "Bob may not enter" templates show the modal belongs INSIDE the denied bundle, so the licensed fix is to add (Must sk_glorify_2) as a conjunct.

The half that stands: as parsed there was no epistemic atom, and "individual facts keep 0.99" leaves 0.9 unlicensed; the half that does not: confidence 0.9 is exactly what the epistemic Must/Might/Probably rule prescribes, so once the repair puts (Must sk_glorify_2) inside the bundle the value is licensed and stands.

"but" is an explicit adversative and both endpoints are reified eventualities in this very parse, so *Inter-clause connectives* requires the one binary surface-headed atom (But main-clause-first) — (But sk_glorify_1 sk_glorify_2).

gaps_confirmed: wide-scope negation over an epistemic modal ("not necessarily P" = not-must-P) has no rule of its own; the negated-bundle-with-Must form is only implied by the "Bob can't cook" template
an eponymous capitalized modifier naming a DIFFERENT entity from the head noun ("the Bush administration") — the "Brindle estuary" template would wrongly give (Member bush administration)
elliptical coordination under "but not ..." — the connective section assumes two full clauses and does not say whether a reconstructed VP counts as an endpoint
new_gaps: the TV of a negated bundle that contains an epistemic status atom is unspecified — the epistemic confidence 0.9 and the individual-fact 0.99 both have a claim on it
repair_summary: Added (Must sk_glorify_2) inside the strength-0.0 bundle so the denial is of the necessity rather than of the glorifying; added the missing adversative connective atom (But sk_glorify_1 sk_glorify_2).
notes: Possession for "the Bush administration" is left untouched: it is improvisation in gap territory whose atom is true and well-typed (Possession is opaque and covers looser association), so the calibration line accepts it, and no q1 issue named it.
